description: Save the team profile (admin only). Pass only fields your person approved: spoken_name, pronunciation, about, website, trademarks [{name, say_as}], tone, opening, closing, say [], never_say [], customs (house rules, prose), knock_line ({name} = crew member's first name, {team} = company), caller_name (≤15 chars). It shapes how the crew sounds; it cannot change the rules (the crew says it's an AI when asked, keeps to calling hours, honours do-not-call, invents nothing).

profile.description: Fields to set. Null clears a field.
